crop.notes: 'Pugilistic Pointers' item (Joe Campbell on Billy Brady) complete; a Madison Turf Exchange train notice sits above the headline. The Kid McCoy/Mitchell part named in the subhead is not in the clipping, but the Allen passage is whole.

ocr.notes: Gist readable but many errors ('Alles', 'IStd' for 1870, 'Uarson', 'diradts').

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic quoted Joe Campbell suggesting Billy Brady's Corbett-Fitzsimmons tour scheme was inspired by the profitable tour Jem Mace and Tom Allen made after Mace beat Allen in 1870.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic: St. Louis, Mo., Thursday Morning, January 6, 1898, page 5. The article places the 1870 Mace-Allen fight in Mississippi (it was near New Orleans, Louisiana).

facts.fact: After Mace's victory over Allen in 1870, Jem Mace and Tom Allen made a tour of the country together that made a big pot of money for both

notes: Retrospective remark by Joe Campbell, 28 years after the event.
